hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; git fetch -q origin main 2>/dev/null; b=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/main 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$b" ] || [ "$b" = 0 ]; then exit 0; fi; printf "{\"systemMessage\":\"git: %s commit(s) behind origin/main - PULL BEFORE READING HANDOFF.md or any tracked file.\",\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"SessionStart\",\"additionalContext\":\"This working tree is %s commit(s) BEHIND origin/main. Per CLAUDE.md: pull then read, never read then pull. Run git pull before reading HANDOFF.md or any tracked file, and before stating anything about project state.\"}}" "$b" "$b"

description: Project settings: shared tsc/vercel read permissions, plus a SessionStart hook that fetches origin/main and warns when this working tree is behind (CLAUDE.md: pull then read).
